positions.name: AsyncRememberExtractionWatch
positions.frame: How does a client watch a remember extraction without blocking the call or losing its work when it drops the receipt?
positions.why: Both segments answer how a client follows a remember extraction after the call returns. src-1 sets the contract: an immediate receipt in seconds, progress observed by polling a cursor, no blocking call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt. src-2 names the two observation paths that follow from a dispatch: the agent polls the run, or the reaction is piggybacked on a later call. Both read the same question of how the extraction is watched, so they share one frame. src-2 is a memo author's declaration, while src-1 is Wynn Castellano's ratification; they agree on the mechanism and add no tension.
